string.name: desc
string.value: The Beast Tamer's abilities increase with each level.\r\nCan be obtained at level 60.

string.name: pdesc
string.value: Growth Spurt increases by 200% for 30 minutes whenever the Beast Tamer levels.\r\nLikewise, EXP gain doubles whenever Growth Spurt levels.\r\nThese two effects can stack.
